name: classification-training
description: Processing container for training a classification model on preprocessed numpy volumes

templates.description: Train a ResNet classification model against tags fetched from OpenSearch

env.name: TAG_TO_CLASS_MAPPING_JSON
env.description: Comma-separated list of at least two tags to classify (used to build the tag-to-class-index mapping).

env.name: DIMENSIONS
env.description: Spatial dimensionality of the input volumes, e.g. '3D' or '2D'.

env.name: PATCH_SIZE
env.description: Patch shape (as a Python tuple literal string) matching the preprocessing container's output shape.

env.name: MODEL_CHECKPOINT_NAME
env.description: Name of the trained model. Allowed characters are lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_'. A UTC timestamp is appended, and the result is stored in config.json of the "model" output.

env.name: RUN_ID
env.description: Not injected by KaapanaTaskOperator (see migration-notes.md) — used only for the TensorBoard log subdirectory and a debug log line, not for checkpoint identity. Statically overridden per DAG in workflow_definition.py rather than exposed as a workflow_parameter, since nothing downstream reads training's TensorBoard logs (see migration-notes.md) — collisions between runs are harmless.

env.name: KAAPANA_PROJECT_IDENTIFIER
env.description: Identifier of the project that started the run. The workflow-api sets it for every task. It is used to look up the OpenSearch index of the project in the access-information-interface.

inputs.name: preprocessed
inputs.description: Expects one subdirectory per case, named after the case identifier, containing a single <identifier>.npy file.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Checkpoint(s) (model-best.pth.tar and/or model-end.pth.tar), config.json, and training.log for this run. Consumed by persist-model's "model" input, which stores it in the shared /models volume and syncs it into the kaapana-backend database.
